predictions.rationale: Defines the Critic class, whose Javadoc exactly matches the description (simple agents that analyze design and suggest improvements). Central to the feature.
Represents the Designer entity that coordinates critics and background analysis, strongly related to the described agents.
Manages a collection of Critic instances and controls their execution, directly implementing the agent concept.
Abstract control mechanism for invoking critics in the background thread, integral to continuous analysis.
Standard implementation of the ControlMech that schedules and runs critics continuously.
Supports combining multiple critics into compound agents, extends the core Critic functionality.
Stores the improvement suggestions generated by critics; closely tied to their output.
Represents individual suggestions from critics, part of the agent feedback loop.
Initializes and starts the critic subsystem when ArgoUML launches.
Specialized ToDoItem for UML, reflecting critic advice specific to UML designs.
